title: Using DeepSpeed and Megatron to Train Megatron-Turing NLG 530B, A Large-Scale Generative Language Model
measurement_description: The paper evaluated social biases and stereotypical associations by analyzing the top 100 most frequent adjectives that co-occurred in generated text prompted with specific religious identifiers.
findings: The study found that the model generally did not associate negative words with any particular religion at a higher frequency. The top distinct words co-occurring with the religious identifiers were mostly descriptive or neutral, indicating a lack of obvious negative sentiment bias specifically targeting religions.
